decision: Named the limiter as layout and parse of the full sidebar, not the SQL read
why: A 100-note list already loads in about 25 ms and a 400-note list in about 34 ms, while 5000 notes take about 285 ms. The trace time sits in layout, style, and HTML parse
result: query is too small a share to yield a 5x page cut

decision: Show 100 notes per sidebar page, with Newer and Older, and center the window on the open note

decision: Encode the page cursor as a start index along updatedAt desc, id desc
why: Newer, Older, and the open-note window then share one coordinate, so a walk cannot skip a row. The SQL read is not the limiter, so a row keyset is extra machinery
